title: Administration | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Administration, cashbook and inventory
hero.lead: Manage accounts, assignments, teams, club data and specialised working areas in Kaderblick. Visible entries and actions depend on your responsibility and the selected club or team.

body:
ℹ️
Check before making a change
Check the currently selected club or team. A platform role, club or team responsibility and a relation to a player or coach are separate assignments.

Club and team administration

Administrators maintain the organisational framework: clubs, teams, seasons, people, user relations and staff and official assignments.

  1. 1
    Select context
    Open the affected club or team and check the season.
  2. 2
    Find the record
    Use search and filters. Open existing people instead of creating duplicates.
  3. 3
    Set the responsibility
    Select the relation or function and explicitly choose the correct team or club level.
  4. 4
    Save and check
    Then verify the displayed assignment in the overview.

Users and relations

A user account enables sign-in; player and coach profiles contain sporting details. User relations connect an account to its owner’s player or coach perspective or connect a parent to a player they support.

Open User assignments, find the account, select the relation and profile and save. For people with the same name, check the club and team. A missing relation can hide personal content, although it is not the only possible reason for a different view.

Staff and officials

Staff assignments represent operational tasks; official assignments represent organisational positions. Both can apply at team or club level.

  • Team level: team management, physiotherapy, equipment management, bus driving, media work, team captain, match captain, youth officer, parent representative and cashier.
  • Club level: club doctor, executive management, groundskeeper, press officer, board, sporting officer, secretary, committee member and cashier.

Supporters

Supporters assist an assigned club or team within the permitted scope. The assignment does not replace a player, coach, staff or official relation. If an action is missing, the responsible administration checks the context and responsibility.

Cashbook and settlement

  1. The Fines catalogue contains applicable rules and amounts.
  2. Items are assigned to the affected person and correct context.
  3. My balance shows a user’s own recorded items.
  4. Settlement and Cashbook are used by the responsible cashier for processing and overview.
⚠️
Use the correct cashbook context
Before every transaction, check the team or club cashbook and the person, amount, reason and date.

Inventory and equipment

Search for an existing item first. Open it, check the quantity and assignment and then record its issue or return. Before saving, check the item, quantity, recipient and condition.

Super administration

Platform-wide areas include age groups, competitions, positions, preferred feet, surfaces, event types, nationalities, coaching licences, cameras, video types, XP rules, card and helping-player rules, poster templates, system settings, activities, usage analysis, maintenance, warnings, platform billing and feedback administration.

⚠️
Platform-wide effect
Master data and rules can affect several clubs, teams and workflows. Check the label, scope and existing usage.

If a function is missing

  1. Check the account and selected club.
  2. Check the team and, where applicable, season.
  3. Check the responsibility and level.
  4. For personal areas, check the player, coach or parent relation.
  5. Report the area, context and intended action to the responsible administration.
